item.title: Cuisillos Complete Comeback to No. 1 on Regional Mexican Airplay With ‘Aunque Me Duela’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our music news update. Today, we're celebrating a major milestone for the Mexican group Cuisillos. After 19 years, they've secured their second number one spot on a national US-based Billboard chart.
[Soft music transitions in the background]
Host: Their song "Aunque Me Duela" has surged to the top of the Regional Mexican Airplay chart, earning the Greatest Gainer honors with a 30% increase in audience. This isn't their first time at the top, though. Back in 2007, they reached number one with "Mil Heridas" for two weeks.
[Short music pause]
Host: Cuisillos has been making music since 1987 and has a unique style, known for their Native American-inspired stage outfits, which pay tribute to their heritage. They've had four top 10s on the Regional Mexican Airplay chart, with their first being "Cartas Marcadas" back in 2001.
[Soft music continues]
Host: "Aunque Me Duela" is also climbing the Latin Airplay chart, reaching number four, and marking their second top 10 on that survey. And with that momentum, they've debuted at number 22 on the Hot Regional Mexican Songs chart.
[Outro music starts]
Host: Congratulations to Cuisillos on this impressive achievement. We'll be keeping an eye on their journey. Thanks for tuning in to our music news update.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
